description: Zod schema with .passthrough() — verify parsed output isn't passed to DB write unfiltered

patterns.label: .passthrough() in file with DB insert/update — mass-assignment risk

examples:
import { z } from "zod";
const schema = z.object({ name: z.string() }).passthrough();

import { z } from "zod";
export const userInput = z.object({ name: z.string() }).strict().passthrough();
